author: Jean E. Lane
text: We chose the right septic company when we called Anzaldo Septic Service. We called for a pump out. The owner, Jeff, came out to do the work. It's been about 22 years since we've looked at the system, but now the problems were starting. Jeff did say we needed the drain field replaced. Can't say we were surprised. He determined exactly what we needed and gave us an estimate while he was here. We prepared ourself for the worst, BUT, was surprised at the fair and reasonable price. Of course, we had the work done. Our new drain field is installed, no more problems, and the two men who came out were very nice and knowledgeable. Right after their work was finished the Inspector came out and took a look, he passed it without any hesitation. So glad it's done and by the right people! So, yes, we highly recommend, Anzaldo Septic!

author: Michael Wilson
text: I would like THANK Mr Jeff and his team for doing such a wonderful job on our 2 drain fields, one at church and one at parsonage. They did such a great job and we would like to Highly Recommend them to the Sorrento Community and beyond!

author: Claudia
text:
Jeff and Austin Anzaldo are very courteous, helpful, and knowledgeable regarding septic issues and solutions.  They addressed our concerns and questions in respectful and kind ways. Their equipment is top of the line.
We are grateful for the professional replacement of the septic drain field of our home in Orange county and expect to enjoy it for 15 years or more!

author: Carlo Renda
text:
Highly recommend this company, especially the owner Jeff.
He / they communicate follow through and are pleasant to deal with and are very competitive in pricing.
If you have any septic issues or want good professional advice you will not go wrong in contacting Jeff’s company

author: Erika Goldberg
text: This company is fantastic! They came out same day and got the job done in no time flat!!!! Will absolutely be using them again and I highly recommend them. I live in a more rural area so getting someone to come out is always tough but they had no issue. Thank you guys so being so great!
